context: Evaluates correct use of camera mode state and toggle action from the wormhole context. Tests that cameraMode is read from useWormholeState, that toggleCameraMode from useWormholeActions is called on interaction, and that the displayed mode accurately reflects context state.

checklist.name: cameraMode Reading
checklist.description: useWormholeState().cameraMode is read and the component correctly handles both 'first-person' and 'third-person' string values

checklist.name: toggleCameraMode Call
checklist.description: toggleCameraMode() from useWormholeActions is called when the user triggers the toggle, with no arguments passed

checklist.name: Reactive Display
checklist.description: The displayed mode label updates reactively when cameraMode changes in the context state

checklist.name: Default State
checklist.description: On initial render without prior toggles, cameraMode is 'first-person' as set by WormholeProvider's initial state
